title: Unit Event — Lead With Courage and Kindness — Episode7 For The Best Performance

meta.Event Outline: Honami considers Mr. Shindo's question of what kind of music she aspires to, but finds herself feeling restless as she's unable to find an answer. Meanwhile, Mr. Shindo discusses Leo/need with the president of Solis Records.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Good evening, Mr. Shindo.
Um... How can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry. I know it's late.
I was hoping to discuss dates with you regarding what Mr. Ota said about wanting to see your band perform.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <The earliest he's free is next weekend, so I'd like for you all to be ready by then.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I don't think any of us has anything scheduled then...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I'm really not sure we'll be able to blow him away like we're supposed to the way we are now...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, I'm sorry...
Next weekend? I'll let the others know.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
<You sounded a little worried is all.
I'll be more than happy to listen if something is bothering you.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <After all, it's my job to as your manager.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <I see. You tried discussing what each song is really about in order to get on the same page, but that caused you to lose some of that energy you had before...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes...
But I was hoping this method would help us stay in sync more...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Actually, the solution to that's fairly simple.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Someone just needs to carry the band.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Based on what you just told me... It sounds like your band is currently like an orchestra without a conductor.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <You're all looking to each other for clues as to what to do, which is causing you to lose focus.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
<So, how do you solve that problem?
Simple...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Someone needs to step up and lead.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <That person will need to understand where each member is at and drive the band forward. They'll need to know what every song is about and how you should all be feeling as you play.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <That should allow you to play as a single unit with plenty of energy. In other words, you'll be able to perform at your best.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(One of us has to lead while playing...
That should solve both problems and allow us to perform the way we're supposed to.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's my duty as the leader to carry our band forward... I have to do whatever it takes to ensure that we perform at our best.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I don't “have to”...
I want to.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <I see. I was hoping that's how you'd respond, Ms. Mochizuki...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <However, putting this plan into practice won't be so simple. The person leading needs to be very skilled technically.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <These skills require more than just a day or two to learn. It's going to take time.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I knew this wasn't going to be easy...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I don't want to give up...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Because if I don't do something, we'll never be able to play at our best.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Which means our audience won't be moved by our performances, and neither will Mr. Ota...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And Leo/need... Everything we're aspiring to achieve... We won't be able to...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (No, I don't want that to happen...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I don't want any of us to feel any regret. I want everyone who comes to see us perform to understand exactly what we're trying to do...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm fully aware that I still have a lot to learn as a performer.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But I want to do this.
Because I want us to put on amazing performances...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't know how I'm actually going to make that happen...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'll practice as much as I need to in order to become the leader that we need...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <However, you won't be able to reach that level overnight.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <If you still feel compelled to do something about this, it'll mean practicing much harder than ever before.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Even then... The benefits will be marginal.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Still, if you're willing to fully commit...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Let's do some training together, Ms. Mochizuki.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: U-Umm... I'm looking forward to working with you today.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, why don't we just dive right in...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Haha. I'm guessing you're wondering what I could possibly know about playing musical instruments.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The truth is, I used to dabble in them myself. I tried all kinds, so I know how to play several.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
But words alone probably aren't enough.
So, let me play something for you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The way he's snapping his wrists. They're so flexible... There's no way he was only “dabbling”...!)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, let's get started, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Practicing the drums is all about maintaining a steady rhythm for as long as possible. Not only does that involve staying in tempo for on-beats, but also never missing any off-beats. Listen for the ticking and match that timing.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You need to be able to adapt to any situation. It's all but impossible to perform on stage as well as you do during practice. So, the goal for practice is to achieve perfection.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: A good paradiddle requires having perfect control over each stroke.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Up, down, tap.
The muscles in your arms will also need to learn how to automatically adjust and switch between them.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
You're forgetting about the rebound.
And your rhythm is starting to fall apart.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Succeeding just once isn't enough.
Each note needs to be even and clean. No matter how tired you are, you have to maintain a steady beat and volume...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I want us to perform at our best...
So I need to learn to carry us forward!)
